$description: test-ui token rules (data). tokens.theme_parity: a token declared in one theme scope and not the other. tokens.off_literal: component CSS bypassing var(--…) for color / border-radius / font-size (families configurable via config.tokens.literal_families). Both are minor: listed, ledgerable, never red on their own.

tokens.theme_parity.measure: token path present in every theme scope

tokens.off_literal.measure: color / radius / font-size literals outside the token table
